description: RFC 9180's test vector for the suite Share seals keys with: base mode (0), DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256) (KEM 0x0010), HKDF-SHA256 (KDF 0x0001), AES-256-GCM (AEAD 0x0002), with its first encryption. From the vectors published with RFC 9180, https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke (test-vectors.json). Sealing with skEm as the ephemeral key gives enc and ct; opening enc and ct with skRm gives pt. shared_secret, key and base_nonce are the steps in between. All values are hex.
